text: {"lessons":["Selling winners feels satisfying, but I should not let the pleasure of locking in gains decide the trade; weigh each position’s prospects and portfolio role.","Several profitable sales in A, D, and E did not prevent my account value from falling overall, so I need to judge results at the portfolio level, not stock by stock.","I should avoid repeatedly trimming a position just because it is up; set clear rules for position sizing and when to sell, and apply them consistently to both gains and losses."]}
